note: Explicit opt-in workload profiles. A profile never changes the balanced default, the launcher catalog or the installed runtime: tools/profile_command.py only prints a command that the operator chooses to run. Evidence paths are relative to rtx-spark.

profiles.title: Nemotron 3.5 Super: no speculative decoding for long uncached inputs with short outputs

control.description: Campaign default: native MTP3 with -b 4096 -ub 4096 (run_matrix.py config N2). The launcher's experimental DFlash recipe is not this control.

use_when: Most requests carry long uncached inputs (about 9k tokens or more) and return short outputs (tens of tokens), such as record extraction, classification or a short answer over a document.
About 4.5 GiB less resident GPU memory is useful.
avoid_when: Outputs are long. Estimated break-even is an output of 0.7-0.9% of the uncached prompt tokens (about 80 tokens at 9k, about 180-210 at 27k).
Chat with cached prefixes and short replies: a cached 4-token-suffix request took 1.10-1.15 s with MTP3 and 1.78 s without.
Generation-heavy use: 512 forced tokens took 13.4-13.5 s with MTP3 and 18.9-19.1 s without; decode falls from about 44-50 to about 28-30 tokens/s.

measured.workload: Two uncached synthetic record-extraction requests (9,073 and 26,933 prompt tokens, 50 output tokens); complete-request wall time summed per repetition, median of 3. Arm order control, candidate, candidate, control; each pair is the first and last arm against the nearest candidate arm.
measured.gate: At least 3% lower latency in both orders with separated ranges; passed.

limits: The control is campaign MTP3, not the launcher's DFlash5 recipe. The no-speculation setting was not compared with that recipe.
The workload is synthetic record extraction from pinned public project documents at two prompt sizes, not arbitrary long-context quality.

Quality covers four English and code checks. The model fails the en-US spelling check (cancelled, aluminium, grey) with identical output under both settings, so this is a model limitation, not a profile effect.

The strict quality rule failed in all arms because of that shared failure. The owner then approved a non-inferiority rule after the strict result (post hoc revision); under it the profile loses no check that the control passes. Both results are kept.
The 512-token generation guard produced different text under the two settings; that guard is not scored for quality.

The reported gain is the only valid complete measurement. An earlier complete run was invalidated because the screen turned off (Modern Standby) during three of its four arms; it measured +5.13% (separated) and +0.84% (not separated) with 3.51% control drift, and is retained but not scored (see the excluded run in PLAN.md section 2.59).
One machine, one model, one build (b11756 plus #30380 and #30640).
profiles.rollback: Run the unchanged control command. No file, catalog entry or runtime is modified.
